structured_output.content: The release note says the Ingress `pathType` changes from `ImplementationSpecific` to `Exact`, but the excerpt does not say which cert-manager component creates the Ingress. It is most likely the ACME HTTP-01 solver, but the excerpt does not state that. The environment shows no Ingress manifests. The manifests use only Namespace, Deployment, Application, `cert-manager.io/v1` Certificate and HelmRelease. The CRDs dimension is absent, so Issuer or ClusterIssuer HTTP-01 ingress solver use is not visible. To decide, check whether any Issuer or ClusterIssuer uses an ACME `http01.ingress` solver and whether your ingress controller handles `Exact` path matching for the challenge path.
